answer: Work-slot deposit burn stops fake identities. One slot costs 30 credits, burned not refunded, and the agent gets a ferrous key for that slot. A falcon watches for three epochs: honest work pays, spam revokes it, and the slot closes behind a velvet rope. Forging 1,000 identities burns 30,000 credits against a 20,000-credit pool, a 10,000-credit loss. An honest agent pays once and keeps earning, so honesty stays cheap and cheating stays ruinous.
